        long pk = in.nextLong();

            System.out.println(0);

            int k = (int) pk;

                dir = -dir;
            }
            ans = (ans * choose(N, c)) % MOD;
            if (k > 0) {
                ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
        in.close();
    }

    static long choose(int a, int b) {
        long res = (fact[a] * inv((fact[b] * fact[a - b]) % MOD)) % MOD;
